metadata.title: Procurement & Tender Management | Adon ERP
metadata.description: Run purchase requisitions, comparative statements, landed cost allocation, and tender management in one connected procurement workflow.

header.title: Procurement
header.subtitle: without the guesswork
header.description: From purchase requisition to comparative statement to PO, from shipment to landed-cost allocation, and from tender publish to award — one workflow, fully traceable.

landedCostSection.title: True landed
landedCostSection.subtitle: unit cost
landedCostSection.description: Track every shipment from goods receipt to landed-cost allocation — freight, duty, and insurance split automatically across received items so your unit cost is always accurate.
features: Shipments linked to goods receipts automatically
Allocate freight, duty & insurance across line items
True landed unit cost flows straight into inventory valuation

procurementSection.title: Requisition to
procurementSection.subtitle: bill, connected
procurementSection.description: Purchase requisition, comparative statement, purchase order, goods receipt note, and bill — every step traceable back to the original request.
features: PO, GRN, and bill matching in one workflow

requisitionsSection.title: Start every purchase
requisitionsSection.subtitle: with a request
requisitionsSection.description: Departments raise a requisition, procurement reviews and approves it, and it becomes the source of truth for every quotation, comparison, and order that follows.
features: Approval routing by amount, category, or department
One-click conversion into an RFQ or comparative statement

comparativeSection.title: Compare vendors
comparativeSection.subtitle: side by side
comparativeSection.description: Pull quotations from multiple vendors into one comparison sheet — price, lead time, and terms side by side — before you commit to a purchase order.
features: Multi-vendor quotation comparison in one sheet
Highlight lowest price, fastest lead time, best terms
Award directly into a purchase order

tenderSection.title: Publish, evaluate,
tenderSection.subtitle: and award
tenderSection.description: Publish tenders, collect bids, run the opening sheet plus technical and financial evaluation, and award — optionally raising a draft PO straight from the winning bid.
features: Publish tenders and collect bids from vendors
Opening sheet with technical & financial evaluation
Award and raise a draft PO from the winning bid

workflowSection.title: One workflow,
workflowSection.description: Requisition, comparison, tender, purchase order, goods receipt, and landed cost all feed the same procurement record — nothing gets re-entered twice.

steps.title: 1. Requisition
steps.description: A department raises what it needs.

steps.title: 2. Compare / Tender
steps.description: Quotations or bids are compared and evaluated.

steps.title: 3. Purchase order
steps.description: The winning vendor is confirmed on a PO.

steps.title: 4. Receipt & landed cost
steps.description: Goods arrive; freight and duty are allocated.

multiVendor.title: Multi-vendor comparison
multiVendor.description: Compare quotations from any number of vendors in a single, structured comparative statement.

landedCost.title: Landed cost allocation
landedCost.description: Split freight, duty, and insurance across received line items automatically.

tenderWorkflow.title: Tender workflow
tenderWorkflow.description: Publish, collect bids, evaluate, and award — with a full audit trail at every step.

approvalRouting.title: Approval routing
approvalRouting.description: Route requisitions and POs through the right approvers automatically.

testimonialSection.joinSubtitle: who grow their business with Adon

testimonial.text: The comparative statement and tender module cut our procurement cycle time in half, and landed cost finally matches what we actually paid.
